title: Path of Destruction
next_chapter_hook: When Chen Ji's will becomes the origin of the new world, all things welcome true freedom through his sacrifice.

text.content: The Tianji Record Fragment slowly manifested between Chen Ji's brows, and the golden light of the complete version enveloped the entire Tianqing Sect. Through the Eye of Heavenly Secrets, he gazed upon all beings in the Three Realms, yet in the most familiar corner, he saw that unforgettable face—Su Qingyao standing at the Tianqing Sect Mountain Gate, her eyes hollow, as if she had never known him.

In that moment, Chen Ji's heart felt as if gripped by an invisible hand. He had orchestrated the world, leaving nothing to chance, yet never imagined the Eye of Heavenly Secrets' punishment would be making his beloved forget his existence. "Qingyao..." he called softly, his voice carrying a tremor never heard before, "Look at me, I am Chen Ji."

dialogue.content: (Gazing at him with hollow eyes, as if looking at a stranger) Who are you? This is not a place you should be, servant disciple.

text.content: Chen Ji laughed, that smile more wretched than crying. He, Chen Ji, had schemed his entire life, playing the world between his fingers, yet at this moment, he lost completely. The cruelty of fate does not lie in it taking your life, but in making the person you love forget your existence.

"Enough." Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes, and when he opened them again, they held a cold, resolute determination. "Eye of Heavenly Secrets, did you think this could make me submit? Hmph... You underestimate me, Chen Ji." His voice was terrifyingly calm. "Since you want to play, I'll play a big game with you—the third path."

dialogue.content: (A grand voice resounds from the void, carrying absolute arrogance and disdain) The third path? You are merely a piece I placed on the board. What third path could you possibly have?

choice.prompt: How should Chen Ji respond to the Eye of Heavenly Secrets' mockery?

choices.text: Detonate the torn Tianji Record to unleash the complete version's power
choices.description: Use the rejection between the fragment and the complete Tianji Record to trigger devastating force, annihilating together with Heavenly Secrets.
choices.visible_reward: Annihilate together with the Eye of Heavenly Secrets,换取万物新生
choices.risk_hint: Sacrifice the self, possibly forever dissipated

text.content: Chen Ji hurled the fragment in his hand toward the void. Golden light instantly surged. In the moment the fragment collided with the complete Tianji Record, devastating force erupted like the creation of heaven and earth.

choices.text: Summon all allies to meet destruction together
choices.description: Gather Su Qingyao, Ye Qing, Chen Nian and others, using everyone's power to jointly bear the Heavenly Fate Value consumption and complete the final strike.
choices.visible_reward: Destroy the Eye of Heavenly Secrets with the power of unity

text.content: Chen Ji formed seals with both hands. Tianji Record's light pierced through the void, summoning Su Qingyao, Ye Qing, Chen Nian's figures one by one. "Everyone, I need your power."

dialogue.content: (Forming from demonic path mist, expression complex) Chen Ji, you finally called me. I've waited for this day... for far too long.
(Eyes still hollow, yet frowning slightly upon seeing Chen Ji) Though I don't remember who you are... my heart tells me I must help you.
(Stepping out from the void, eyes reddened) Brother... I finally found you. Even if Heavenly Secrets erases everyone's memory of you, I will always remember.

text.content: Chen Ji looked at them, eyes slightly reddened. He had orchestrated his entire life, treating everyone as chess pieces, yet at this moment discovered the true chess piece was never others, but himself. And these people were willing to journey to destruction with him.

choice.prompt: Facing those willing to share life and death with him, what choice should Chen Ji make?

choices.text: Accept their power to complete the final strike
choices.description: Gather everyone's power in the Tianji Record and detonate together, annihilating with Heavenly Secrets.
choices.visible_cost: Everyone bears the Heavenly Fate Value consumption
choices.visible_reward: Destroy the Eye of Heavenly Secrets with united strength

dialogue.content: (Extending hand, pouring all demonic path mist into Tianji Record) My life was saved by you. Today, I return it to you.

choices.text: Bear it alone, not letting them face danger
choices.description: Refuse their power, complete the sacrifice alone, protecting their safety.
choices.visible_reward: Solo destroy the Eye of Heavenly Secrets, protecting everyone
choices.risk_hint: Power may be insufficient, requiring a desperate gamble

text.content: "No." Chen Ji shook his head, voice resolute. "This path I must walk alone. You all... see the new world for me."

Just then, the void trembled violently. The Eye of Heavenly Secrets' voice rang out again, this time carrying a fluctuation never seen before: "Chen Ji... you truly intend to do this? Do you know, once you detonate the Tianji Record, you will be forever dissipated, not even a chance at reincarnation?!"

Chen Ji laughed heartily toward the sky, that laughter carrying boundless exhilaration and desolation: "Eye of Heavenly Secrets, you're finally panicked? Ha ha... I, Chen Ji, orchestrated my entire life, leaving nothing to chance, yet made one miscalculation—the true variable... was my own heart."

dialogue.content: (Hollow eyes suddenly rippled with fluctuation) Chen Ji... this name... why does my heart ache so much...

choice.prompt: Su Qingyao's memories begin to recover. How should Chen Ji face this?

choices.description: Use Tianji Record's power to forcibly awaken her memories, letting her recall all past between them.
choices.visible_cost: Consume large amount of Heavenly Fate Value
choices.visible_reward: Su Qingyao remembers all, restoring complete memories
choices.risk_hint: May accelerate Heavenly Fate Value consumption

dialogue.content: (Tears suddenly gushing from her eyes) Chen Ji... I remember... you are Chen Ji, the waste disciple I've been investigating all along... and also the most important person in my heart...

choices.description: Not letting Su Qingyao remember everything, letting her continue living with an empty heart, unburdened by the self about to dissipate.
choices.visible_cost: Give up the final chance to reunite
choices.visible_reward: Su Qingyao safe, continuing life in the new world
choices.risk_hint: Forever lose the chance to reunite with her

text.content: Chen Ji gently shook his head, a tender smile forming at his lips: "No need, Qingyao... forgetting is fine... this way you can... live well."

Chen Ji took a deep breath, both hands suddenly forming seals. The complete Tianji Record slowly unfurled above his head, golden light illuminating the entire Three Realms as bright as day. He glanced back at Su Qingyao one last time, those eyes carrying boundless tenderness and resolution.

"Everyone—" Chen Ji's voice echoed through the Three Realms, "I, Chen Ji, schemed my entire life, never imagining that one day I would do a truly great deed for the world's common people. Eye of Heavenly Secrets, you wish to manipulate fate? Today, let me show you—what it means to defy heaven and change destiny!"

As his words fell, the Tianji Record detonated with a thunderous roar. Devastating force swept through the Three Realms. The Eye of Heavenly Secrets let out a heaven-shaking roar of fury, yet could not stop this world-destroying strike. Chen Ji's figure gradually dissolved within the golden light, yet his face bore peace and relief never seen before.

Su Qingyao rushed toward him like a madwoman, yet was repelled the moment she touched the golden light. She could only watch helplessly as the man she once investigated and later fell in love with turned to nothing within the radiance. "No—Chen Ji—" Her scream echoed through the heavens.

However, in the instant Chen Ji was about to completely dissipate, a gentle voice sounded in his ear: "Silly child... you did well." That was Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul. Using his final power, he merged himself into the core of the Tianji Record. "Go... turn your will into the origin of the new world."

The complete power of the Tianji Record erupted fully within Chen Ji. In that moment, he felt power unprecedented. He saw the essence of Heavenly Secrets—a cage woven from countless threads of fate. And he would shatter this cage completely.

"Eye of Heavenly Secrets—" Chen Ji's voice回荡在虚空中, "You lost. Not to my schemes, but to... the simplest yet most powerful thing in this world." His figure completely dissolved, yet that voice echoed like great bells, "It is love."

The Eye of Heavenly Secrets let out a final heaven-shaking wail. The massive consciousness collapsed within the golden light. Threads of fate in the Three Realms broke one by one. All beings felt unprecedented freedom in this moment. Chen Ji's will turned into a gentle radiance, merging into this newly born world.

Su Qingyao knelt on the ground, tears falling silently. She didn't know what happened, but she knew something important had forever left her. Ye Qing helped her up, softly saying: "He won... we are all free." Chen Nian gazed at the sky, murmuring: "Brother... are you watching? This is the new world you spoke of..."

All things reborn. Without the Eye of Heavenly Secrets' manipulation, the Three Realms' beings controlled their own fate for the first time. Deep within the origin of this reborn world, Chen Ji's will如同初升朝阳, gently watching over this land that gained freedom through him. Though he dissipated, his will would eternally guard this new world where fate was no longer manipulated.
